anchor.problem: Exhaustive endpoint path-specific setup analysis can require expensive multi-signal continuation; evaluate whether paired suffix differences provide a cheaper exact comparison representation.
anchor.engineering_user: Timing-closure engineer deciding whether a declared setup endpoint needs an ECO.
anchor.downstream_need: Complete worst endpoint PBA slack and violation decisions with lower total turnaround, identical declared-model outputs and honest coverage.
anchor.causal_mechanism: Query-directed product DAG over two compatible prefix states taking the same suffix edges; certify an upper bound on executable severity difference and delete only endpoint-dominated states.
mechanism_invariants: Same suffix language and timing context for both states.
Pair the same edge before taking a maximum; include endpoint setup.
Account for full executable arrivals/rounding, or label a result real-model-only.
Unsupported/budget-exhausted queries retain states or exact fallback; no silent omissions.
Strong scalar backward suffix and signal-bound controls receive all shared cache and scheduling optimizations.
All overhead is charged; difference in representation must yield actual user-relevant benefit.
forbidden_pivots: Claiming backward propagation, dominance, generic interval arithmetic or caching as novel.
Restricting B+ to coarse bounds or removing scalar demand-driven reuse.
Replacing exact endpoint outputs by learned predictions, cluster pessimism or bounded-depth clean verdicts.
Switching to an unsupported proxy or multidimensional production-signoff claim to evade a negative result.

combination_drift.rationale: Initial new-ID anchor; no revision or scientific clearance. Routine-composition risk is explicit and unresolved, not erased by zero initial drift.

demand_drift.rationale: Initial user decision fixed; restricted-slice demand remains a gate, not a passed fact.

revision_assessment.reason: Initial EDA-0004 anchor. Explicit successor changes predecessor objective/mechanism and therefore receives a new topic ID; old adverse scores remain in lineage.

abandonment.rationale: No same-target joint consent, exhaustive novelty failure or universal dead-end proof. Current unresolved position is not abandonment.
resurrection_conditions: Demonstrate nonroutine distinction and fully charged net-work witness vs unrestricted exact scalar B+.
Prove executable arithmetic and suffix/context legality.
Validate scoped demand, representative rights, actual resources and exact task consensus.
